name: mor-desk
description: MOR Identities, the owner's desk: a client for several MOR test identities, with no command line. An inbox of drafts from the Claude connector, each read in plain words with its digest, to approve, decline or send back with a note; and each identity's received messages, replies, acknowledgements and payments, sorted into to answer, answered and ignored. Test identities only. Machine, allegedly's answering: its agency terms (the nudge cMIP), the owner's own acts answered at once, other people's notified until he picks one, nudges within their number; drafted with Claude through Anthropic's API under a daily cap, the key on this machine only.
